title: Matcha Pancake with Chocolate Sauce
description: A twist on traditional Japanese-style pancakes, topped with a rich chocolate sauce. Perfect for a romantic breakfast.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, matcha powder, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan and cook until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook until golden brown.
While the pancakes are cooking, melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Serve the pancakes with the warm chocolate sauce drizzled on top.
Garnish with a sprinkle of matcha powder, if desired.
